name: You Are Going To Die Today
source:
Emily opened a chat to kill boredom. She didn’t expect death to log in with her.

[From [url=https://frostedwyrm.itch.io/you-are-going-to-die-today]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
艾米莉为了打发无聊，打开了聊天室。她没想到，死神也跟着她一起上线了。
